description: This file implements a configuration file storage system for Mattermost, including methods for creating, resolving paths, loading, saving, and managing configuration files and their contents.

classes.name: FileStore
classes.description: A struct representing a configuration file storage backed by a file path, with methods to load, save, and manage configuration files.

methods.name: NewFileStore
methods.description: Creates a new FileStore instance, resolving the file path and optionally creating the file if it does not exist.

methods.name: resolveConfigFilePath
methods.description: Resolves a given configuration file path to an absolute path, searching in common directories if necessary.

methods.name: resolveFilePath
methods.description: Resolves a filename to an absolute path based on the store's configuration file path.

methods.name: Set
methods.description: Replaces the current configuration with a new one, respecting read-only settings.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Serializes and writes the configuration to the backing file.

methods.name: Load
methods.description: Loads the current configuration from the backing file.

methods.name: GetFile
methods.description: Fetches the contents of a persisted configuration file.

methods.name: GetFilePath
methods.description: Returns the resolved path of a configuration file.

methods.name: SetFile
methods.description: Sets or replaces the contents of a configuration file.

methods.name: HasFile
methods.description: Checks if a specific configuration file exists.

methods.name: RemoveFile
methods.description: Removes a persisted configuration file, skipping absolute paths.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the store, indicating the file path.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Performs cleanup of resources, if necessary.
